name: Kroger
verdict: Concern (held for a maintainer): a listed company whose largest holders are US investment firms; in June 2025 a Michigan jury ordered it to pay more than $75m to an HVAC technician left partly handless by a refrigerant explosion.
note: Held for a maintainer, proposed tier concern: the new record claim kroger-injury-verdict-2025 is a court finding of injury against the company itself, and no state or fund is in the ownership chain, so the September 2026 'none' is held back. In June 2025 a Michigan jury ordered Kroger to pay more than $75m to a technician left partly handless by a refrigerant explosion at a Kroger store (kroger-injury-verdict-2025); Kroger has appealed. Earlier: re-rated 2026-09-27 (docs/rating-review-2026-09-27.md): was concern; its record (fines, settlements, financing) is not a human-rights finding (METHOD.md).

why.text: Kroger's largest owners are US investment firms (BlackRock, Berkshire Hathaway and State Street), so no state is behind it. In June 2025 a jury ordered Kroger to pay more than $75 million to an HVAC technician who lost part of both hands when a defective refrigerant exploded at an Oakland County store — a court finding of injury against the company itself.
why.messageLine: In June 2025 a Michigan jury ordered Kroger to pay more than $75m over an HVAC technician's injuries.
